x:
Kandukuri Veeresalingam Pantulu was one of the greatest social reformers in Andhra Pradesh and is widely regarded as the Father of the Telugu Renaissance. At a time when female education was neglected, Veeresalingam took the pioneering step of establishing the first girls' school at Rajahmundry in 1874. He firmly believed that education was essential for the empowerment of women and for the progress of society. Apart from promoting women's education, he campaigned vigorously for widow remarriage, opposed child marriage, and fought against social superstitions. This title recognizes Veeresalingam's pioneering contribution to modern social reform in Andhra Pradesh. Hence, the correct answer is Option (1).

Who founded the Varthamana Vyavaharikandhra Bhasha Parivartaka Samaj?
x:
Gidugu Venkata Ramamurthy founded the Varthamana Vyavaharika Andhra Bhasha Parivartaka Samaj to promote the use of spoken (Vyavaharika) Telugu instead of the highly Sanskritized classical language. He believed that education and literature should be written in a language easily understood by ordinary people. His movement revolutionized Telugu prose and greatly influenced modern Telugu literature, journalism and education. Hence, the correct answer is Option (2).
